story.titleZh: 塞恩斯赞德福特练习赛砂石路受损，正接受调查
story.summaryZh: 卡洛斯·塞恩斯在赞德福特大奖赛练习赛中因多次驶过“激进”的砂石路导致赛车部件受损，被迫使用竞争力较差的部件，并在冲刺赛排位赛后因涉嫌“不必要慢速行驶”接受调查。

story.originalTitle: Sainz’s car compromised by trips through “aggressive” Zandvoort gravel in practice
story.summaryEn: Carlos Sainz Jnr sustained damage to his car after going off into the "aggressive" gravel multiple times during practice for the Dutch Grand Prix, forcing him to revert to less competitive components, and he is under investigation for potentially driving unnecessarily slowly in sprint qualifying.
detailZh: 小卡洛斯·塞恩斯表示，在荷兰大奖赛练习赛中受损后，他不得不换回竞争力较差的部件。
他还暗示，威廉姆斯车队在准备于阿塞拜疆大奖赛为赛车引入重大升级时，备件库存已经不多。塞恩斯在第一次练习赛中三次冲出赛道，打乱了他为今天的冲刺赛排位赛所做的准备。
“今天早上我在赛车的平衡方面遇到了很大困难，不幸的是几次冲进了砂石区，”塞恩斯说。“我们损坏了赛车上相当多的部件，所以在我的第一次练习赛中，我无法使用正确的部件，而我们在本周末剩余时间里必须装到车上的部件，在下压力和性能输出方面都不是最好的。”
“但事实就是这样。在巴库获得升级之前，我们在所有方面都有点紧张，不幸的是这条赛道的砂石路相当激进，会损坏赛车上相当多的部件。所以我们会努力在冲刺赛中尽可能多地学习，然后应对本周末剩余的比赛。”
尽管如此，塞恩斯对他在冲刺赛排位赛中的表现感到满意，最终他在发车格上排名第18。“显然SQ1的关键在于前两圈，”他说，“而我在第一次练习赛中没能获得正确的认知，所以并不是说我能做出两个非常好的圈速，因为最终你会因为从第一次练习赛中缺乏了解而吃亏。”
“但考虑到我跑的圈数很少，而且我的赛车状况很受影响，我认为我做出了几个不错的圈速。”
排位赛后，赛会干事宣布塞恩斯因在排位赛期间可能“不必要地慢速行驶”而接受调查。
塞恩斯的队友亚历山大·阿尔本证实，车队车手们必须小心，以免耗尽备用部件库存。“显然我们使用这些赛车已经有一段时间了，我们有一段时间没有升级了，所以它们有点磨损，我们必须好好对待它们。”
detailEn: Carlos Sainz Jnr says he has had to revert to less competitive components after sustaining damage during practice for the Dutch Grand Prix.

He also indicated Williams are running low on their stock of parts as they prepare to introduce a major upgrade for their car at the Azerbaijan Grand Prix. Sainz went off three times during the first practice session which disrupted his preparations for today’s sprint race qualifying session.

“I struggled a lot this morning with the balance of the car and unfortunately went off into the gravel a few times,” said Sainz. “We damaged quite a lot of parts on the car, so in my FP1 I couldn’t run with the right components and the components that we have to put on the car for the rest of the weekend are not the best in terms of downforce and performance delivery.

“But it’s what it is. We are a bit tight on everything until we get the upgrade in Baku and unfortunately the gravel in in this track is quite aggressive and it breaks quite a lot of parts of the car. So we’ll try and learn as much as possible in the sprint and we’ll take the rest of the weekend.”

Nonetheless Sainz was pleased with his effort in qualifying for the sprint race, which left him 18th on the grid. “Obviously SQ1 is all about the first two laps,” he said, “and I didn’t get a proper read in FP1 so it’s not like I could do two very good laps because in the end you’re suffering with the lack of knowledge that you carry from FP1.
“But given how little I ran and how compromised my car is, I think I did a couple of good laps.”
After the qualifying the stewards announced Sainz is under investigation for potentially “driving unnecessarily slowly” during the session.

Sainz’s team mate Alexander Albon confirmed the team’s drivers are having to take care not to deplete their stack of spare parts. “We’ve obviously had these cars for a while now, we haven’t upgraded for a while, so they’re a little bit worse for wear, so we have to treat them nicely.”
keyPointsZh: 塞恩斯在第一次练习赛中三次冲出赛道，打乱了冲刺赛排位赛的准备工作。
威廉姆斯车队因等待阿塞拜疆大奖赛的重大升级，目前备件库存紧张。
队友亚历山大·阿尔本确认车手们必须小心驾驶以避免耗尽备件。
keyPointsEn: Sainz went off three times during the first practice session, disrupting his preparations for sprint qualifying.
Williams are running low on spare parts as they prepare to introduce a major upgrade at the Azerbaijan Grand Prix.
Teammate Alexander Albon confirmed the drivers must take care not to deplete their stock of spare parts.

relatedItems.originalTitle: Colton Herta “maybe underestimated the difference” from IndyCar – F2 boss
detailZh: F2总监：赫塔可能低估了F1和IndyCar之间的差距
布鲁诺·米歇尔建议，赫塔在转向F2的过程中遇到了比他预期的更大的困难，但他希望这位美国车手能够反弹。
F2首席执行官布鲁诺·米歇尔表示，赫塔可能低估了F1的二级系列和IndyCar之间的差距，这位26岁的车手的勇敢职业转变至今尚未成功。
赫塔在美国顶级单座赛车系列中一直是领跑者，但决定在2026年回到欧洲——在2015年和2016年参加了跨大西洋的青训车队比赛——以追求他的F1梦想。
在凯迪拉克的F1新车队中获得了测试和开发角色后，赫塔被分配了掌握F2的任务，以便为可能的世界锦标赛晋升做准备。
然而，他在F1的二级系列赛中的首个赛季结果远低于预期。这位加利福尼亚人目前在车手积分榜上排名第19，而且他在整个赛季中的表现水平实际上有所下降——这让他感到困惑——几起事故加剧了他的问题。
“这比我想的要困难得多，因为科尔顿是一个非常强的车手，这一点毫无疑问，”米歇尔评论道。
“他和我们可能低估了我们与IndyCar车队相比的工作环境差异，但我不认为这必须成为一个例子，我真心希望他能够以高水平结束本赛季。我们仍然在为此希望。”
法国人指出，F2复杂的周末赛制，仅有45分钟的自由练习和30分钟的排位赛，可能是赫塔表现不佳的原因之一。
他也有一些不错的比赛，但在排位赛中遇到了更多困难，也许这也是我们遇到的限制之一，因为在30分钟内你需要找到正确的时机[进行你的跑圈]，你只有两次在轮胎上的飞驰圈数，而你在这段有限的时间内几乎没有赛道时间，”米歇尔说。
这也是我们为F1培养车手的方式，因为你知道在F1中你也有有限的赛道时间。
所以，他可能为此而挣扎，并且比他预期的承受了更多的痛苦。现在我真的希望，真诚地希望，他能够以高姿态结束本赛季——他应得的。
赫塔本人对自己的赛季剩余比赛感到不确定，因为卡塔尔和阿布扎比的比赛因伊朗战争而受到威胁，然而米歇尔重申这些赛事“不会取消”。
至于赫塔的未来，Hitech车手明确表示他对第二个F2赛季“没有兴趣”，但他不会排除这种情况，如果凯迪拉克希望他为车队效力。
detailEn: Colton Herta “maybe underestimated the difference” from IndyCar – F2 boss
Bruno Michel suggests Colton Herta struggled “more than what he expected” on his switch to F2 but hopes the American can bounce back
Formula 2 CEO Bruno Michel says Colton Herta “maybe underestimated the difference” between Formula 1’s feeder series and IndyCar, with the 26-year-old’s bold career move so far unsuccessful.

Herta was a frontrunner in America’s premier single-seater series for seven years but decided to move back to Europe in 2026 – having competed in junior formulae across the pond in 2015 and 2016 – in order to chase his F1 dream.
Having landed a test and development role with Cadillac’s nascent F1 team, Herta was tasked with mastering F2 in order to prepare for a potential graduation to the world championship.

However, his maiden season in F1’s feeder series has ended up well below expectations. The Californian lies 19th in the drivers’ standings, and his performance level has actually worsened throughout the year – which he has been at a loss to explain – with several crashes compounding his issues.
“It's been more difficult than what I thought it was going to be, because Colton is a very strong driver, there's no doubt about that,” Michel commented.

“He and we maybe underestimated the difference of working environment that we had compared to IndyCar teams, but I don't think it has to be settled as an example, and I really hope that he's going to finish the season in a high. We're still hoping for that.”
The Frenchman pointed to F2’s tricky weekend format, with just a 45-minute free practice session and a 30-minute qualifying round ahead of the two races, as a potential cause for Herta’s struggle.

“He had some good races as well, he had more difficulties in quali, and maybe also that's one of the limits that we were having, because in 30 minutes you come up with the right timing [for your runs], you have two flying laps on sets of tyres on which you have very limited track time,” Michel said.
“That's also the way we prepare drivers for Formula 1, because you know in Formula 1 that you have limited track time as well.
“So, probably he struggled for that and he suffered from that a bit more than what he expected. Now I really hope, sincerely, that he's going to finish the season on a high – he deserves it.”

Herta himself was unsure he was going to get any more races to finish the season given the Qatar and Abu Dhabi rounds are known to be at threat due to the Iran war, however Michel reaffirmed these events “will not be cancelled”.
As for Herta’s future, the Hitech driver made it clear that he had “no interest” in a sophomore F2 season, but he won’t rule it out in case that’s what Cadillac wants for him.
keyPointsZh: 赫塔在美国顶级单座赛车系列中一直是领跑者，但决定在2026年回到欧洲。
赫塔在2015年和2016年参加了跨大西洋的青训车队比赛。
keyPointsEn: Herta was a frontrunner in America’s premier single-seater series for seven years but decided to move back to Europe in 2026.
Herta competed in junior formulae across the pond in 2015 and 2016.
Herta’s F1 dream has not yet been realized.
